verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations are a fair question for an open-finance API platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a batch or bulk endpoint for acting on many accounts or customers at once. The cited material covers only single-item services (account ownership, balances, transactions, data refresh) and webhooks, none of which is a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
